saints.name: John the Discalced
saints.legacy: A life of humility and service
saints.summary: Blessed John the Discalced was a Franciscan friar known for his austere lifestyle and dedication to serving the poor and sick. He spent many years as a parish priest, walking barefoot to visit his parishioners and living a life of extreme mortification. He is remembered for his prophetic gifts and his compassionate service during times of plague, ultimately dying from the very scourge he sought to alleviate.

saints.name: Maximin of Verdun
saints.summary: Saint Maximin of Verdun was an abbot and a prominent figure in early medieval monasticism. He was known for his miraculous works, including providing for the needy during a famine and healing the blind. His leadership attracted many young men to the religious life, and he is remembered for his piety and dedication to God.
